verdict.rationale: USCIS publishes a documented developer platform (Torch) with onboarding, a sandbox, and production keys. It offers two APIs: a Case Status API and a FOIA/PA request-and-status API that can create requests and check their status. The core of the product, filing forms, paying fees and managing a case, has no API and runs only through the myUSCIS online account, so only a narrow slice of the product can be driven programmatically. Missing for 10: a filing/form-submission API, fee-payment and address-change APIs, broader case-management endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the APIs working.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Case Status API: Provides case status information to USCIS customers and their representatives who require regular access to case status information.
This API allows consumers to create a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) or Privacy Act (PA) request, for Alien File material, about or on behalf of the subject of record.
Gain Access and develop in our Sandbox environment to send test data.
Pass the demo and receive production keys to launch your application.
There is no filing API; myUSCIS is the only online filing rail.
